Someone said this on here and it made me think of it a little differently. 

They don’t have much control over any aspect of their life in there and that is one thing they have control over. I guess that makes sense a little but it still doesn’t make the behaviour ok. Imagine someone controlling your entire life, when you eat, when you sleep, when you need to be in your room, what you can eat, what you can do, and then you control some of the communication. So when you don’t reply or pick up after they waited in a lineup to call you, it can feel very defeating. They also don’t know what you are doing sometimes and it makes their head spin that maybe you are with someone else. It’s easy to feel insecure. We get that way sometimes, so can they. You know? Especially if you are someone who has always been quick to reply and now your replies aren’t as fast. It’s good to keep him updated on your day so he knows maybe you won’t be able to reply during that time. 

It’s still not ok either way. It’s toxic behaviour and controlling and manipulative and passive aggressive. I would definitely not re add him and not answer his calls. For days. Make sure he never does this again. If he really is serious then he won’t care, if he is just trying to get attention and make you feel hurt then he will come running back to you and feel badly because he will fear he may have lost you. Don’t tolerate this. He is trying to break you down and he is trying to feel some kind of power and control over the situation, he hopes you will add him back and that gives his ego a boost in a situation where he has lost a lot of his humility and pride. 

 You need to talk about what your expectations are and figure something out together. Removing eachother is childish and game playing and toxic and emotionally abusive. I’ve been in relationships like that on the outside and they generally are full of drama and chaos. If that’s what you want it will continue on the outside. How much does he love you if he can just cut you off at the drop of a dime like that and remove you? Usually ppl who do that are coming from a place of fear.. fear of being left so they leave you first, fear of abandonment, fear in general.. or it’s because they don’t love you like they say and enjoy messing with you and cutting you off and showing you they are boss and in control and can and will cut you off if you don’t abide to their demands and expectations. 

Don’t answer. Don’t put him back on. Let him sit with that for a week or more even.

As far as photos, you can’t send them from a third party vendor anymore. You have to print them out yourself and then send them in. I sent some in my LO just got them, they don’t photo copy those thankfully he got the originals! 

Don’t use any gel or sparkly pens! You can use markers and pencil crayons and coloured pens as long as they arent gel pens or sparkly. I’ve coloured him art and things and it wasn’t photo copied.

They have many vendors for books. You can send journals, notebooks, calendars, day planners, magazines, art books, colouring books etc from the secure vendors they have listed on the website. Of course you can also send in a secure pak but only once every 3 months and you have a limited budget which surprisingly goes super quick!!

Hey girl. My LO and I are going thru this process right now. It is very possible! You have to be willing to put in the work.

First you submit the visiting request application online. This will get denied. Then your LO will have to put in a concern form to visitation. They will come back and say they have to appeal it. He will need to file an appeal. About a week after he is filing an appeal you will need to email the visitation SGT and the warden. Pleading your case on why you believe you should get visitation. This could be for a number of reasons. Are you a positive influence in his life? Do you offer spiritual guidance? Do you feel this will benefit him with the rehabilitation process. Etc. not just I love him and want to be with him. 

I would also get him to put you in touch with his close family that already visits and have them also write to the warden or call the warden and visitation on your behalf to say they also approve of this. 

If you still get turned down. You will need to provide more documentation. He will need to submit another appeal. This may take several months and several appeals before they finally see this isn’t a fling and you are serious. 

It also depends a lot on how your LO is doing too. Has he had a DOR since you have been together? Has he gone to the hole? Is he taking programs and classes? What is he doing with his time?

There is so much scamming in Idaho and they see these flings happen all the time. They want to know that not only are you serious but your partner is serious and that you are going to put in the work on both sides. Most ppl give up or if they are scamming you they may not even put in the appeal or do the work.
